item.title: Conservation easement and migration route designation safeguard a ‘Path of the Pronghorn’ bottleneck
item.description: When an oil and gas company bid $19 per acre to drill a pinchpoint where the Sublette Pronghorn Herd migrates across the New Fork River, the 2023 lease sale turned into one of the largest fights in Wyoming wildlife circles.

item.title: How the death of two CIA agents in northern Mexico led to a treason case
item.description: The deaths of two CIA agents in April after a drug lab operation in northern Mexico have led to treason charges against a former Chihuahua state attorney general.

item.title: Egyptian editor faces trial after hours of questioning
item.description: Egyptian prosecutors referred Lina Attalah, editor-in-chief of independent news outlet Mada Masr, to trial on a charge of operating a website without a license, after questioning her for more than six hours.

item.title: Florida officer took possession of man's home after finding him dead 4 years ago, police say
item.description: Investigators in Florida say a police officer who found a man dead during a welfare check in 2022 is accused of taking possession of the man’s home and impersonating him for years while fixing up the place.
